subject: WIP: use usb-ctrl for USB gadget management

comments.message:
Patch Set 1: Ok-To-Test+1

User approved, CI ok to start

Patch Set 1:

The jsnbd_git.bbappend needs RDEPEND to phosphor-misc which installs usb-ctrl.

And here is my phoshpor-misc recipe (the usb-ctrl is not merged yet though)

+SUMMARY = "A collection of miscellaneous OpenBMC function"
+HOMEPAGE = "http://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-misc"
+PR = "r1"
+PV = "0.1+git${SRCPV}"
+LICENSE = "Apache-2.0"
+LIC_FILES_CHKSUM = "file://LICENSE;md5=e3fc50a88d0a364313df4b21ef20c29e"
+
+inherit meson pkgconfig allarch
+
+EXTRA_OEMESON = "-Dusb-ctrl=enabled"
+
+SRC_URI += "xxx"
+SRCREV = "xxx"
+
+S = "${WORKDIR}/git"
